original_reference_provenance.finding: Historical Julia emits a zero-key PASS after a one-element marker kernel; actual concurrent B-link insertion, node splitting, allocator and query computation are absent.

source_exposure: native and repaired CUDA.jl; JACC additionally saw validated KA
scope_limits: 256 and4096 unique keys; every hit and miss query, aligned query warp sizes.
No delete/range modes, duplicate conflict semantics, arbitrary concurrent schedules or partial-query-warp safety certification.
Canonical leaf records remove physical slot order, internal shape and allocator identities.
Named build+search kernel region excludes allocations/copies/freeing in original main.
